title: Only intrusive or sampled telemetry is available
justification: Passive accum_stats(), timing, result, model, and formula metrics are already available and reliable for aggregate behavior.
Cadical195 exposes IPASIR-UP callbacks and is_decision() for observed literals.
Observation and propagator callbacks can perturb inprocessing and solver execution, so the data cannot be treated as transparent production telemetry.
scope: A small paired pilot on the existing ER-60 graph at U=112 and U=127, using uninstrumented, connected-no-op, and <=1% stratified observed-variable conditions in fresh processes.
stop_if: formula identity or SAT result changes
connected-no-op control materially differs from baseline
callback lifecycle changes a following independent solver call
callback overhead or perturbation cannot be separated
